2608.23120.title: Statistical Machine Translation Systems of English-Pnar Language Pair : Some Insights of the Emperical Study
2608.23120.paper_summary: Pnar, an Austroasiatic language spoken by approximately 0.4 million people in the Jaintia Hills of Meghalaya, lacks the digital corpora and natural language processing (NLP) resources. This paper presents the first machine translation study for the English and Pnar language pair. Using articles collected from the Wyrta newspaper, we built a parallel corpus comprising of 10,234 sentences and trained phrase-based statistical machine translation (SMT) systems the models using 9,563 parallel corpora under three configurations for each direction using Moses, GIZA++ , KenLM, varying lexicalized reordering and minimum error rate training (MERT) tuning. The models are evaluated on a held out test set of 371 sentences, the best performing system achieves a BLEU score of 14.97 (chrF2: 33.42, TER: 77.60) for Pnar to English and 11.16 (chrF2: 31.38, TER: 93.51) for English to Pnar, establishing the first quantitative benchmark for this language pair. Lexicalized reordering improves translation quality by 3.73 BLEU points for Pnar to English, reflecting the structural shift from the source language's SOV word order to the target language's SVO order, whereas MERT tuning degrades BLEU performance under low resource conditions. Finally, we analyze the remaining translation errors, including morphological out of vocabulary (OOV) words, long-distance reordering and Khasi code mixing and discuss future directions toward neural and multilingual machine translation for Pnar.
2608.23120.paper_summary_zh: Pnar是一種奧斯特羅亞細亞語言，約有40萬人在梅加拉亞的賈因提亞山脈使用，缺乏數位語料庫和自然語言處理（NLP）資源。本文呈現了英語與Pnar語言對的首個機器翻譯研究。使用從Wyrta報紙收集的文章，我們建立了一個包含10,234個句子的平行語料庫，並利用9,563個平行語料在三種配置下為每個方向訓練基於短語的統計機器翻譯（SMT）系統模型，使用Moses、GIZA++、KenLM，變化的詞彙化重排序和最小錯誤率訓練（MERT）調整。這些模型在371個句子的保留測試集上進行評估，表現最佳的系統在Pnar到英語的BLEU分數達到14.97（chrF2：33.42，TER：77.60），而英語到Pnar的BLEU分數為11.16（chrF2：31.38，TER：93.51），為這對語言建立了首個定量基準。詞彙化重排序使Pnar到英語的翻譯質量提高了3.73 BLEU點，反映了源語言的SOV詞序向目標語言的SVO詞序的結構轉變，而MERT調整在低資源條件下降低了BLEU表現。最後，我們分析了剩餘的翻譯錯誤，包括形態學的詞彙外（OOV）單詞、長距離重排序和卡西語混合，並討論了未來在Pnar語言的神經和多語言機器翻譯方向。
